harnesses.claude-code: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:10101 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="$OCX_BRIDGE_TOKEN" harbor run -d {dataset} -i {task} -a claude-code -m zai/{model} --ak version=2.1.316 --ae "ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS=Authorization: Bearer $OCX_BRIDGE_TOKEN" -n 1 -o {outdir} --job-name run
harnesses.codex: OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:10101/v1 OPENAI_API_KEY="$OCX_BRIDGE_TOKEN" harbor run -d {dataset} -i {task} -a codex -m zai/{model} --ak reasoning_effort=medium --ak version=0.162.1 --ak 'config={{"skills":{{"include_instructions":false,"bundled":{{"enabled":false}}}},"features":{{"memories":false}}}}' -n 1 -o {outdir} --job-name run
harnesses.hermes: PYTHONPATH=$PWD OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:10101/v1 OPENAI_API_KEY="$OCX_BRIDGE_TOKEN" harbor run -d {dataset} -i {task} -a p1agents:HermesPinned -m openai/zai/{model} --ak version=v2026.9.21 --ak toolsets=terminal,file,web,todo -n 1 -o {outdir} --job-name run
harnesses.zcode: PYTHONPATH=$PWD OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:10101/v1 OPENAI_API_KEY="$OCX_BRIDGE_TOKEN" harbor run -d {dataset} -i {task} -a p1agents:ZCode -m zai/{model} -n 1 -o {outdir} --job-name run
